entries.note: The view fetches through the authenticated API and displays a local object URL, leaving capability tokens out of image URLs. Every root/path/refresh change cancels the previous request and revokes its URL. Cleanup also runs when FlexLayout remounts a moved tab. Paths and roots stay in persisted tab config; only display mode is local state. Browser natural dimensions reflect orientation, while the service checks raw source dimensions for its pixel budget. Corrupt image data may pass metadata inspection, so onError remains a visible retryable state.
